D.t: Marcy Kaptur leads by 6.7 in the forecast and wins 85% of simulations. The cushion is about 21,378 votes; a one point swing is about 1,591 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +1.2 and D +14.8. A normal polling error decides it.
$1.2M cash against $807K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
